[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Unique Number of Occurrences** [LC 1207 · Unique Number of Occurrences](https://leetcode.com/problems/unique-number-of-occurrences/){difficulty="Easy"}

Count twice. A first frequency array (shifted by $1000$, because values can be negative) gives each value's count; a second array over the counts $1..n$ counts how many values share each count. The answer is `false` as soon as some count is used twice, and the values that never occur must be skipped.

[Solved in full in @sec-arr-p5-b.]{.card-link}
